# dependencytrack_service_account (Data Source)

Retrieves a Dependency-Track service account, including its team memberships and directly granted permissions. Requires Dependency-Track 5.2 or newer and the `ACCESS_MANAGEMENT` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dependencytrack_service_account" "ci" {
  name = "ci-pipeline"
}

output "ci_permissions" {
  value = data.dependencytrack_service_account.ci.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the service account, without the `svc:` prefix

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The email address of the service account
- `id` (String) The ID of the service account (same as `name`)
- `permissions` (Set of String) The permissions granted to the service account directly. Permissions inherited from its teams are not included
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the service account is suspended
- `teams` (Attributes List) The teams the service account is a member of, ordered by name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))
- `username` (String) The full username of the service account: its name with the `svc:` prefix

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the team
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the team
